description.zh: 域名名称，查询指定域名的转移记录。
description.en: The domain name. Use this parameter to query the transfer records of a specific domain name.

description.zh: 域名来源账号ID，查看从该ID账号转移给本账号的域名列表
description.en: The ID of the source account. Use this parameter to query the list of domain names transferred from this account to the current account.

description.zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。

取值：

zh：中文 

en：英文

   默认取值为zh。
description.en:
The language of the response.

Valid values:

zh: Chinese

en: English

The default value is zh.

description.zh: 当前页数，起始值为1，默认为1。
description.en: The page number. The value starts from 1. The default value is 1.

description.zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值100，默认为20。
description.en: The number of entries per page. The maximum value is 100. The default value is 20.

description.zh: 域名去处账号ID，查看从本账号转移给该ID账号的域名列表
description.en: The ID of the destination account. Use this parameter to query the list of domain names transferred from the current account to this account.

description.zh:
转移类型。取值范围：

- IN：转入到本账号的列表
- OUT：本账号转出的列表
description.en:
The type of transfer. Valid values:

- IN: The list of domain names transferred to the current account.

- OUT: The list of domain names transferred from the current account.

title.zh: 获取跨账号转移DNS权限列表

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns describe-transfer-domains --lang en --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --transfer-type IN --domain-name example.top --from-user-id 10000000 --target-user-id 10000000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns DescribeTransferDomains --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 20 --PageNumber 1 --DomainName 'example.top' --FromUserId 10000000 --Lang en --TransferType IN --TargetUserId 10000000
